in_marathi.name: Nandiniji
in_marathi.long_meaning: Nandiniji हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit words 'nand' meaning joy and 'nandini' meaning giver. Represents one who brings happiness.

in_bengali.name: Nandiniji
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Joy Giver
in_bengali.long_meaning: Nandiniji একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Derived from the Sanskrit words 'nand' meaning joy and 'nandini' meaning giver. Represents one who brings happiness.
